title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
summary: Cyera is acquiring Oasis Security for $1 billion to address security needs for AI agents. This is the third acquisition Cyera has made this year.
content: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.

zh.title: Cyera同意以10亿美元收购Oasis Security以保护激增的AI代理
zh.summary: Cyera以10亿美元收购Oasis Security来解决AI代理的安全需求。这是Cyera今年进行的第三次收购。
